target: W07 / P4 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001 (L3, operator gate GATE-W07-L3-001 granted 2026-09-11): decouple audit identity, audit artifact storage, candidate branch and PR readiness in NEW code only. Structured AuditIdentity replaces model-specific audit enums for new records; an EvidenceLocation model distinguishes the substantive candidate branch from the evidence store; the AUDITED_HEAD == FINALITY_HEAD invariant is enforced as a pure check; the PR Steward boundary (CHECK_ONLY, NO_FIX, NO_APPROVAL, NO_MERGE, NO_AUDIT_AUTHORING) is encoded as a classifier over proposed steward actions; legacy embedded_audit records are projected into AuditIdentity with UNKNOWN layers so proof self-reference compatibility is preserved (nothing removed). Base is the A1-audited W01 head 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875. Live PR Steward, embedded-audit CI, proof schemas and audit_broker schemas are OUT of scope.
invariants: MACRO I08, I09, I10, I16, I17, I18, I19 and section 10 W07 apply. Gate: OPERATOR_GATE_RECEIPT_W07.md (gate_id GATE-W07-L3-001) binds this packet's allowlist; any path outside it, and specifically schemas/**, tools/pr_steward/**, .github/workflows/**, config/audit/**, .control-tower/**, pyproject.toml, tests/governance/**, and every sibling prefix (dispatch/, environment/, receipts/, freeze/, join/, review_economy/), is STOP_SCOPE_EXPANSION and also a gate violation.

AuditIdentity is a frozen dataclass with exactly these fields, all required strings unless noted: runner, runner_version, requested_model, configured_model, response_claimed_model, provider_attested_model, provider, effort_requested, effort_observed, auth_profile_ref, containment, network_posture, independence_class (validated against enums.v1 independence_class values), qualification_receipt (a {path, sha256} ref or the literal 'NOT_RUN'). The literal 'UNKNOWN' and 'NOT_EXPOSED' are legal values for any string field and are never coerced or inferred (I16): the module has no function that fills provider_attested_model from response_claimed_model or vice versa; a test asserts the five identity layers stay distinct after every operation.

independence(implementer: AuditIdentity, auditor: AuditIdentity) -> IndependenceAssessment(class_, reasons) is pure and fail-closed: DIFFERENT_FAMILY_AND_RUNTIME requires provider differs AND runner differs with both provider fields not UNKNOWN; DIFFERENT_FAMILY requires provider differs; DIFFERENT_RUNTIME requires runner differs; SAME_FAMILY_DIFFERENT_SESSION requires same provider and different auth_profile_ref or runner_version; any UNKNOWN on a compared field yields UNKNOWN. A same-runner, same-provider, same-auth_profile pair is reported as SELF_CERTIFICATION_RISK in reasons (FR-001) and class UNKNOWN. The function returns an assessment; it never approves an audit.

EvidenceLocation(kind in {CANDIDATE_BRANCH, EVIDENCE_STORE}, ref) with classify_location(path) -> kind: paths under proof/**, proofs/**, out/**, reports/** and any path ending in .proof.json, PROOF.json or AUDITOR_REPORT.md are EVIDENCE_STORE; everything else CANDIDATE_BRANCH; a split(changed_paths) -> (candidate_paths, evidence_paths) helper; the doc states the target architecture: candidate branch carries only substantive candidate content, evidence store carries validation/audit/finality evidence.

exact_head_binding(audited_head, finality_head, freeze_head) -> HeadBinding(bound: bool, reasons) is pure: bound only when all three are equal 40-hex git oids; any inequality or malformed value yields bound False with the mismatching pair named. No other module path can produce bound True.

PRStewardBoundary: constants CHECK_ONLY, NO_FIX, NO_APPROVAL, NO_MERGE, NO_AUDIT_AUTHORING; classify_steward_action(action: str) -> ALLOWED | FORBIDDEN over a closed vocabulary: ALLOWED = {READ_PR, READ_CHECKS, READ_REVIEWS, COMPUTE_READINESS, EMIT_READINESS_CLASSIFICATION}; FORBIDDEN = {PUSH_FIX, COMMIT, APPROVE_REVIEW, REQUEST_CHANGES, MERGE, MARK_READY, AUTHOR_AUDIT, WRITE_PROOF, MODIFY_BRANCH_PROTECTION}; unknown action -> FORBIDDEN (fail closed). READY is a classification string only; the module exposes no merge, approve or write function.

Legacy compatibility: project_legacy_embedded_audit(record: Mapping) -> AuditIdentity maps auditor_tool -> runner, auditor_model -> requested_model AND configured_model (the legacy schema has one model field), provider derived ONLY from an explicit closed table {agy: google, antigravity: google, gemini-cli: google, claude-code-cli: anthropic, copilot-cli: github, grok-cli: xai, opencode-cli: UNKNOWN, pal-mcp-clink: UNKNOWN, none: NONE}; every field the legacy record lacks becomes 'UNKNOWN' (never inferred from branding); invocation string is preserved verbatim in an extra `legacy_invocation` attribute on the returned projection wrapper, not on AuditIdentity. The legacy record itself is never modified; nothing in schemas/proof/** changes.

All outputs carry authority 'NONE'; no readiness or approval predicate exists beyond the classification strings above. Pure module: no filesystem writes, subprocess, clock or network; schema enum values are read via pathlib.Path.read_text() only (the literal token open( is forbidden in src).

Base commit exactly 1c915b9141e9a5c3d835a5c7ea953381782ae875 in worktree .worktrees/gec-v2-w07 branch feat/gec-v2-w07-audit-identity-001. No push by the implementer (push is team-lead performed under D8). No model audits; no TO/ConPort/dope-memory/GitHub mutation; no placeholders; ASCII only; ruff clean; type hints; frozen dataclasses; one substantive attempt; semantic ambiguity stops and returns.

## Summary
- W07 (L3, operator gate GATE-W07-L3-001) of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on W01
- AuditIdentity with five distinct identity layers (never reconciled), pure independence assessment (fail-closed, FR-001 self-certification flagged)
- EvidenceLocation split (candidate branch vs evidence store); exact-head binding AUDITED_HEAD == FINALITY_HEAD
- PR Steward boundary classifier: CHECK_ONLY / NO_FIX / NO_APPROVAL / NO_MERGE / NO_AUDIT_AUTHORING
- legacy embedded_audit projection with UNKNOWN layers; nothing under schemas/proof changes
